content.short: Integral is a crypto-focused accounting, treasury management and financial operations platform.
content.description: Integral is a crypto-focused platform for accounting, treasury management, and financial operations. It connects to your financial stack by linking public wallets or API keys to pull in and consolidate transaction data. Once imported, Integral automatically prices assets, reconciles entries, and calculates capitalized gain/loss on each transaction, helping you maintain accurate records and streamlined financial reporting across multiple chains.

resources.title: DAO Taxes: The Ultimate Guide
resources.tldr: Governance tokens create tax positions that nobody agreed to take on. Covers how a DAO can stay compliant when the entity itself may not legally exist anywhere.

resources.title: How to Prepare for the Transition to Account-Level Cost Basis
resources.tldr: New IRS rules mandate wallet-by-wallet lot tracking rather than one pooled basis. If you have been reporting the old way, this is the change that forces a rebuild.
